chose: Asking home to hear a take again (#3339) is one slice of state, `lib/hear-again`, that every screen showing takes composes, as they compose the play slice: Takes on home and Takes › Needs your attention today. It is offered on any take home says it will hear again (`hearAgain` on each take of both reads), heard ones included, as the owner widened it (a take marked heard can be mis-heard). It is disabled while home is hearing it or until the time home names, and that time is shown under it. Home holds the snooze; the phone only shows what home says, and a fresh read replaces what an answer laid over the take. One ask is under way at a time, and an answer counts only for the ask made last. On Needs your attention, a take home says holds nothing to hear leaves the list; any other answer keeps it listed. The button disables itself only on what home last said, not on this phone's clock, so a snooze that has run out lets the take be asked again on the next read (opening the page, a pull down).
options: one shared slice, offered on any take home says it re-hears (chosen)
a third act in Needs your attention's own act union (`ReconcileAct`): the first shape, but Takes would need a second copy of the same state
a re-hear button that asks home blind, with no snooze shown: nothing would say why a second tap does nothing
gray: Where the ask is offered, what disables it and what it says are on the screen; no check settles them.
undo: Drop the slice from the two machines and their screens, `hearAgain` from both reads and the ports, and `lib/hear-again` in soundbites and www.
